overview.title: A multiservices office for families and small businesses.
overview.text: Pick a service to see what it covers, or call and talk it through with our team.

services.title: Tax Preparation
services.text: Personal, business and corporate tax returns prepared by our team in English or Spanish. Tax service is available in all 50 states.
services.lead: Tax preparation is the heart of what the office does. We prepare personal, business and corporate returns for individuals, families and small businesses across Harris, Galveston and Brazoria counties, and our tax service is available in all 50 states.

covers.title: Individual returns
covers.text: Your return prepared in person at the office by appointment, in English or Spanish.

covers.title: Business and corporate returns
covers.text: Returns for small businesses and corporations, prepared to keep you compliant with the IRS.

covers.title: Eligible deductions
covers.text: We work through the deductions you are eligible for while keeping the return compliant.

covers.title: All 50 states
covers.text: Tax service is available in all 50 states, so you do not have to be in Houston to work with us.

covers.title: Help with your IRS account
covers.text: We point you to the IRS tools for your account and for checking where your refund is.

questions.a: Yes. In-person visits are by appointment. Call (832) 453-2496 or email laura@lltaxpro.com to set a time.

questions.q: Can you prepare my return if I live outside Texas?
questions.a: Yes. Our tax service is available in all 50 states.

services.title: Notary & Apostille
services.summary: Notary and apostille at the office.
services.text: Certified notary service for legal and business documents, with apostille processing for documents going abroad.
services.lead: Our team includes notaries public at the Houston office and at our second location in Brownsville, so documents can be notarized where you are. We also process apostilles for documents that have to be recognised in another country.

covers.title: Houston office
covers.text: Notary service at 17300 El Camino Real, by appointment.

covers.title: Brownsville
covers.text: Notary service with Teresa Sanchez in Brownsville and the surrounding cities.

covers.title: Legal and business documents
covers.text: Certified notary signatures and document certifications for personal and business paperwork.

covers.title: Apostille processing
covers.text: Apostille and authentication processing for documents that have to be recognised internationally.

services.title: Title Transfers
services.text: Title transfers, ownership changes and registration paperwork for automobiles and mobile homes.
services.lead: We handle the paperwork behind a title transfer for automobiles and mobile homes — ownership changes, registrations and the official documentation that goes with them.

services.title: Retirement Planning
services.text: Guidance on retirement strategies, including Roth IRA accounts and 401(k) options, through approved partners.
services.lead: Retirement is long-term work. We talk through the options with you — Roth IRA accounts, 401(k) models and the referrals that go with them — so your money is working toward something.

services.title: Insurance
services.summary: Life, health, auto, home and commercial.
services.text: Life, health, auto, home and commercial insurance, arranged through our office and explained so you understand what you are buying.
services.lead: We help families look at insurance alongside the rest of their finances, and we explain the options in English or Spanish before you decide.

covers.title: Life and health
covers.text: Cover for the people who depend on you, and health cover alongside it.

covers.title: Auto and home
covers.text: Cover for the car and the house, looked at together rather than one policy at a time.

covers.title: Commercial
covers.text: Commercial liability cover for a small business.

services.title: ITIN Assistance
services.text: Help applying for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number so you can file.
services.lead: An ITIN lets you file a return when you are not eligible for a Social Security number. We walk you through the application and the documents it asks for.

services.title: Document Assistance
services.text: Help filling in and preparing documents, including immigration paperwork, with customer support from our team while it is in progress.
services.lead: Paperwork is easier with someone beside you. Our team helps you work through forms and documents, in English or Spanish.

covers.title: Immigration paperwork
covers.text: Document preparation and procedural help with immigration files, applications and forms. This is document assistance, not legal advice.

covers.title: Organising a file
covers.text: We help put the documents a submission asks for in order before it goes in.

services.title: Financial Services
services.text: Investments and financial education, so families can make informed decisions about their money.
services.lead: Our mission is to empower families through financial education. We do not just provide services, we educate, guide and help you make informed financial decisions.

services.title: LLC Formation & EIN
services.text: Complete startup help: LLC formation, EIN registration and guidance on staying compliant from the first day.
services.lead: We help entrepreneurs create lasting income opportunities, starting with getting the business properly formed.

covers.title: LLC formation
covers.text: Your LLC set up and filed so the business exists properly.

covers.title: EIN registration
covers.text: The employer identification number the business needs to open accounts and file.

covers.title: Compliance guidance
covers.text: What the new business has to keep up with once it is formed.

services.title: Tax Preparer Training
services.summary: Learn to become a tax preparer.
services.text: Learn to become a tax preparer, build your business, help families and work from home.
services.lead: If you would rather build something of your own, we teach you to become a tax preparer. Build your business, help families and work from home. The work is commission-based, full time or part time, on your own hours, with training and mentorship from our team.

covers.title: Tax preparer
covers.text: Learn to prepare taxes with training and step-by-step support, and a path to your own tax business.

covers.title: Life insurance agent
covers.text: Earn commission helping families protect what matters most. We guide you through the licensing pathway and provide training and mentorship.

covers.title: Investments license
covers.text: Guidance on the pathway to an investments license and on supporting clients with retirement and financial strategies through approved partners.

covers.title: Mortgage license
covers.text: Support and guidance on the steps to pursue a mortgage license and build a professional path in the mortgage industry.

questions.q: How do I join the team?
questions.a: Call or text (832) 453-2496, email laura@lltaxpro.com, or fill in the recruitment application form.
No. We provide the training. We are looking for motivated, coachable people who want to learn, serve clients professionally and build long-term income.
The opportunities are commission-based. You work your own hours and set your own schedule, full time or part time.
It depends on the role. Licensing requirements and availability vary by role and by state, and we guide you through the pathway where one is needed.

about.title: Serving with integrity, faith and purpose.
text: At LL Tax Pro & Multiservices LLC, our mission goes beyond business — it is about service. We believe God has called us to serve our community with honesty, compassion and excellence.

We care deeply about our clients. We don't just provide services — we educate, guide and empower families to make informed financial decisions. Whether it is tax preparation, insurance, investments, ITIN assistance, notary services or business formation, we treat every client with respect and personal attention.
We are grateful for the opportunity to serve and help families grow financially and confidently.
